verdict.rationale: Base44 offers several programmatic surfaces. There is a CLI to create projects, sync data models and code, deploy, and run commands against any app. There is also an SDK with entity CRUD, an account-level MCP server, sandbox access for your own coding agent, GitHub sync, and code-defined backend resources. None of this establishes parity with the UI, and many editor features have no documented API equivalent: the design board, theming, AI design previews, templates, custom domains, login configuration, Figma/website import and video generation. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 at every candidate path. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, a published REST/OpenAPI spec, documented programmatic equivalents for editor-only features (domains, auth settings, templates, design/theming), and independent hands-on corroboration.
